heroSub: At Delphi Technologies' plant in Izmir ESBAS Free Zone, tool tips used in production were tracked with a Data Matrix-based system to make product-tool matching, tool life, and sharpening processes traceable.
contextP1: Delphi Technologies' plant in Izmir ESBAS Free Zone manufactures for the automotive supplier industry. In this project, tool tips used in production were tracked with a Data Matrix-based system.
contextP2: The project made product-tool matching, tool life monitoring, and sharpening flow traceable and manageable.
problemTitle: Quality risk and visibility loss from wrong tool usage
problemLede: It was necessary to guarantee that the correct tool tip is used for each product in production. Manual checks increased error risk and reduced process visibility.

problemList.text: Manual product and tool-tip checks increased the risk of wrong tool usage.
Lack of healthy tool-life tracking made planning and cost control difficult.
A reliable central record structure was needed to track the history of tools sent for sharpening.

solutionTitle: Data Matrix-based unique tool tracking and automatic validation
solutionLede: Each tool tip was marked with a Data Matrix code and uniquely identified. During production, the tool tip was read and matched with the relevant product; tool life and sharpening records were also tracked in the system.

steps.title: Unique Code Marking
steps.text: Each tool tip was provided with a unique identity via Data Matrix code.

steps.title: Matching Validation
steps.text: During production, tool-tip code is read and automatically matched with the related product.

steps.title: Tool Life Monitoring
steps.text: Usage cycles and life of each tool tip are tracked for data-driven management.

steps.title: Sharpening History
steps.text: Process records of tools sent for sharpening are stored to make sharpening history traceable.

techTitle: Data Matrix reading, field automation, and SCADA infrastructure

techGrid.title: Data Matrix Codes
techGrid.text: Permanent code structure carrying unique identity on tool tips.

techGrid.title: Code Readers
techGrid.text: Read tool-tip codes during production for instant verification.

techGrid.title: PLC Structure
techGrid.text: Manages field flow and synchronizes validation steps with production.

techGrid.title: C# SCADA Application
techGrid.text: Manages product-tool matching, tool life tracking, sharpening records, and Oracle data exchange.

integrationDesc: The system works integrated with Oracle; product-tool matching, tool life, and sharpening process data are shared with Oracle for centralized monitoring and management.

integrationList.text: Production validation and tool lifecycle data are exchanged with Oracle bi-directionally.
Traceability and process management are centrally executed on OnSuite Trace.

resultsTitle: Quality assurance and data-driven tool management

resultsGrid.title: Prevention of Wrong Tool Usage
resultsGrid.text: Automatic product-tool matching reduced quality risk caused by wrong tool usage.

resultsGrid.title: Lifecycle-Based Planning
resultsGrid.text: Lifecycle tracking over unique identities strengthened planning and cost control.

resultsGrid.title: Sharpening History Visibility
resultsGrid.text: Systematic sharpening records made each tool tip's history traceable.
